prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption (redesign), choose_path (copy, hint, layout), finish (layout), and sign_in (hint, notification, reorder) changes, as each has only 1 test so far.
home new_flow changes have 3 tests with positive noise-corrected gains and 1 winning test, showing this kind of change can be helpful.
finish new_screen changes have 2 tests agreeing that no clear effect was seen.
No clear effect was seen for most changes tested so far (9 out of 13 tests).
Predictions generally overestimated impact for most tests, but underestimated the size of major wins like sign_in notification and adoption redesign.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +9.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, copy: -0.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, hint: -6.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, layout: -2.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, layout: +1.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: +2.5% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: -1.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, notification: +4.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Changes:
0: [home, new_flow] Desktop Visibility Diagnostic Flow: Adds an automated desktop overlay diagnostic check during the waiting step to verify the pet will render properly on screen. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets failing to show up on the desktop after onboarding, and the home waiting room has a high mean duration (2336s).)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Control Interactive Demonstration: Inserts a dedicated interactive controls preview screen right before completing onboarding to practice summoning and hiding the pet. (why: Support received 3 emails about confusion on how to control/hide/talk to the pet and 4 emails about misbehaving desktop features post-onboarding.)
2: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Pet Protection Copy Clarification: Updates sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly reassure users that existing cloud pets will sync automatically without losing progress. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or resetting after signing in again, making this the largest support theme.)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Room Interactive Tip Carousel: Adds an interactive tip carousel to the waiting screen explaining pet habits and desktop interactions while background rendering runs. (why: The waiting room step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to drop-off before reaching home finish screen (64.8%).)
4: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Grid Selection Layout: Reconfigures the path selection screen into a visual grid layout for faster path comparison. (why: Choose path takes a mean of 514s despite a fast 8s median, indicating extreme outlier hesitation for a key early funnel step.)
5: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Example Quality Hint: Adds explicit camera lighting and framing guidance text directly below the photo upload component. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual output.)
6: [finish, incentive] First Visit Badge Incentive: Adds a collectible 'Desktop Companion Pioneer' badge banner to the final home intro welcome screen. (why: The finish step has the highest drop-off rate in the funnel, converting only 64.8% of users who reach home intro.)
7: [sign_in, notification] Sign In Retry Alert Notification: Displays a timed status notification banner if sign-in response takes longer than 5 seconds. (why: Support logged 2 emails explicitly describing the sign-in screen stalling or failing to appear.)
